title: Stakes and Shapes
statement: Bob must fix a Rock-Paper-Scissors sequence of length x+y+z (x, y, z ≤ 100) that wins at least as many rounds as Alice whatever order she plays her x Rocks, y Scissors and z Papers. Playing the same move every round makes her order irrelevant: all-Rock nets y-z, all-Scissors z-x, all-Paper x-y. These sum to zero, so by averaging one is non-negative: counter her most frequent move.
